claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings complementary role fully characterized at maximum available scale (22yr/144k). Three modes validated: citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.79-0.85 > 0.75 threshold), section cross-lingual (Sachverhalt cp_64=0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv cp_64=0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen cp_64=0.094 < 0.1 FAILED), linear hybrid complement (PASS adversarial at 19yr+ w=0.3-0.4 but JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF baseline 0.78-0.79). Fundamental two-mode tradeoff confirmed: TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode (JP~0.78, LangDom~0.48); dense embeddings = COMPLEMENTARY modes (citation heritage, cross-lingual, linear hybrid). Full 174k evaluation blocked on corpus lane (bge_/bger_ ID mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: All 21 evidence_refs verified accessible and consistent. Citation heritage: dense AUC 0.79-0.85 (21-22yr, 137k-144k) vs TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, 344/100 positive pairs. Section cross-lingual: 1K sample (359/538/510 decisions), Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150, Erwaegungen 0.094 (cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch). Linear hybrids: weight sweep w=0.1-0.9, optimal w=0.4 (cited_decisions_tfidf JP=0.6725) and w=0.3 (hybrid05 JP=0.6115), both PASS adversarial gates. Center projected FAILS jurist gate all scales (JP 0.05-0.43). Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus: 6-8/14 PASS, citation heritage AUC~0.5. Formal suite 174k: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 JP=0.7345, LangDom=0.477. Negative results preserved: dense FAIL jurist gate all scales, true OOS ceiling ~0.53, v18 hierarchy purity 0.65<0.7, bge_ corpus mismatch, boilerplate resistance negative, Erwaegungen cross-lingual FAIL.
